response.rationale: Probably different concepts. Club Booking is stored by ClubBookingRepository (node 440da90bcde7901a, src/persistence/clubBookingRepository.ts) as 'private readonly bookings = new Map<string, ClubBooking>();'. SessionService.effectiveCapacity calls it, so it appears to hold back capacity in a session, and ClubBookingService.invoice invoices it. Booking is a separate type that ReportService (node a663bd12cbc0090c, src/business/reportService.ts) reads through a different class, BookingRepository.findBySession, and it has its own payment state ('if (b.status === "paid") {'). Separate repositories and different roles suggest two concepts: a club's block reservation of capacity and an individual paid booking. Confidence is moderate because only one line of code is visible on each side.
